relationships.evidence_quote: Quantification analysis of the staining in laminae II showed that 82.8% of SOMtdTomato neurons expressed Cacna1h (Figure 1D).

relationships.subject: Cav3.2
relationships.evidence_quote: Cacna1h knockdown significantly attenuated dynamic allodynia from days 1 to 14 postsurgery (Figure 6B).

relationships.subject: Cav3.2
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, this superficial Aβ pathway was partially closed by Cav3.2 knockdown in SOM+ neurons.

key_findings: Cav3.2 (Cacna1h) is highly expressed in spinal SOM+ excitatory interneurons (82.8% of SOM neurons in lamina II).
Cacna1h knockdown in spinal SOM+ neurons impaired light touch, attenuated CFA and SNI allodynia and reduced nerve-injury-induced Aβ inputs to superficial neurons.
